content.thinking: I went through the page company by company and didn't pick a track, since nothing on it says where to start and many of the terms in the "words I didn't get" list are still unclear to me. If I had to choose, I'd lean toward an S&P 500 track from a big name, with Menora's at 0.52% the cheapest I noticed.
